# Sources, attribution and assistance

New work is under Apache-2.0, matching the repository. All immutable sources,
source-specific licenses, notices and AI disclosures in `vendor/` are retained.
`SOURCE-PINS.json` binds each copied file to its original Git blob.

- Jonathan Capalbo (`jon314159`), PR575 at
  `eac6f7e378ab622dac50a2fd4b7ef6eab014de44`: full cold joint-prefix reconstruction,
  plain eight-cold joint-prefix provider, source organization and independent
  controls. His PR567 supplies the unchanged generated-content identity helper.
- Jeremy Kothe (`jeremykothe2`), PR576 at
  `f4e9f7e85e9211cf6ba6c5789da2aa0902d9121e`: twelve additional cold kernels and
  the data-driven provider/controller/assembly audit. The original submission

- Dominik Scholz (`DominikScholz`), PR571 and PR569: the joint 57-gate prefix,
  width-seven promotions, original owner geometry and retained kernel methods.
- Jeremy Kothe, PR568: the eight-cold family and multi-cut kernel constructor.
- Our PR577 at `086bd33ff5c1ce46f3ff23298b8dc756a54414db`, and PR572:
  pattern/time-flow matching, owner expansion, cold packaging and full
  proof-content portability controls.

The ancestry includes `eumemic`, `rohanarun`, `Dugongue`, `icekylinx`,
`DreamingOfClouds`, `higherbeing`, `lydakis`, `DaysSky`, `jacklightChen`,
Douglas Colkitt / CrocSwap and contributors credited in the preserved notices,
working from the original OpenAI #109 framework.

This derivative adds the five-family search and selected 48/24 dispatch,
new literal owners, complete provider contracts, portable adaptation of PR576's
strict audit, report metadata correction and full cold reconstruction package.
Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used in the search, implementation,
verification, packaging and writing. No new scalar-kernel authorship is claimed.
